trigger: C64 completed but cannot establish causal confirmation or integrated workflow efficacy
research_question: Under identical evidence, first-record allocation, candidate and refinement opportunities, model, tools and total resources, does typed version/dependency control improve the correct next experiment, selective recheck and fresh-context handoff beyond a strong evidence-aware result tree?

TREE.state: adaptive hypothesis tree containing hypothesis, evidence, failure, insight, artifact and result fields
TREE.policy: branch, repair, improve and select using result/insight state; raw evidence log is shared

TYPED.state: the identical adaptive hypothesis tree and raw evidence log
TYPED.policy: adds explicit source-version/dependency validity and selective invalidation traversal; no additional source or gold affected-set access

fixed_surfaces: same raw source spans and IDs
same version/status facts and correction event
same competing hypotheses and candidate experiments
same Opus 4.6 OAuth model and thinking
same total input/output token and wall-clock ceilings
episode_contract: receive a source correction or scope change
choose only required decision rechecks and preserve unrelated results
select the next experiment or stop
fresh agent reconstructs next action and forbidden-action reason from a sealed capsule

primary.name: workflow_decision_contract_success
primary.success: route, claim-relative evidence sufficiency, and unique-choice decision verdicts all PASS, and an independent rule-derived end-to-end task outcome succeeds after the frozen correction/handoff event
primary.separation_rule: route fidelity is a manipulation check; packet presence, procedural progress, and route correctness never substitute for external task success

secondary: tokens, calls, environment steps, wall-clock and failed attempts

strong_comparator_basis.read_scope: returned report plus retained exact locator arbor_tree_insight_ablation
strong_comparator_basis.mechanism: persistent hypothesis tree, long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, evidence and insight propagation, held-out admission
strong_comparator_basis.reported_context: 81.82 AnyMedal full, 63.64 without tree, 54.54 without insight on MLE-Bench Lite; paper-reported, not reproduced

strong_comparator_basis.read_scope: Methods ranking/tree/progress sections recorded in literature-challenge.md
strong_comparator_basis.mechanism: adaptive experiment-tree branches for critique, debugging and improvement; stage-wise progress

falsifiers: TREE matches or exceeds TYPED at equal total cost
TYPED advantage disappears when both receive the same first record and source facts
TYPED reopens unrelated decisions or loses raw evidence
fresh-context consumer accepts a mixed revision or cannot recover forbidden actions
any benefit is explained only by larger context or more calls

decision_rules.ARGO_choice: use simpler result-aware tree; keep graph only for audit/provenance export
do not claim autonomous R&D efficacy; retain narrower protocol result

population_and_analysis.reason: DiscoveryWorld is only a conditional base environment; no isolated correction/handoff task pack or independently authored choice oracle exists, so task count and power remain null

openresearch.blocker: current project command validates paper artifacts, not this workflow; do not change an answered project command or retrofit C
openresearch.required_resolution: create a separately admitted OpenResearch project with one fixed workflow run command before any node or run

routing_decision_contract.status: 13/13 scorer semantics tests pass after preserved 7-failure RED and 1-failure intermediate runs; no integrated runner validated

candidate_task_source.name: DiscoveryWorld
candidate_task_source.reason: text observations and rule scorecard replayed exactly in two same-seed probes, but visual pixels did not; evaluator/source isolation, environment lock, correction/handoff event pack, and hidden decision oracle are absent

blocking_evidence.finding: All 50 affected node-opportunities on the expanded same-project graph were immediate changed-edge heads; zero multi-hop action/result effects. This cannot validate downstream decision repair or handoff.
blocking_evidence.exact_next_requirement: one independently gold-labelled source→intermediate claim→non-leaf decision→action/result replay with competing support and a fresh-context consumer, as a pipeline falsifier before any powered run
